meta.source: Approved Kompass Education and Kompass Learning previews (kompass-learn-refined, kompass-edu-wordmark), 24 October 2026

color.note: Light only: every approved surface sets color-scheme light. Values are the preview's own oklch; hex equivalents are in the usage notes.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: #ffffff. Page background and longer reading. Also text reversed on `ink` (18.5:1).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: #f1f2f3. Grey cards on white: course cards, featured course, syllabus, recommendation cards, filter chips, the preview bar and the selected sidebar item.

tokens.name: mist-hover
tokens.usage: #dcdddf. Hover on an unpressed filter chip (mist mixed with 8% ink).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: #d3d4d7. Hairline rules: header and footer borders, module dividers, mini-cover rule, search underline, progress track. Also the border of secondary buttons, selects and text areas, where it is 1.5:1 on white: below the 3:1 control-border floor, kept exactly as approved.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: #55585d. Secondary text: meta rows, course card descriptions, captions, placeholders, lesson durations. 7.1:1 on `white`, 6.3:1 on `mist`, 6.2:1 on the soft tints.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: #121417. All headings and reading text on `white`, `mist` and the soft tints (16:1 and above), and on `coral` (5.2:1). Fill for primary buttons, pressed chips, the avatar, the video frame and the reversed wordmark plate.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: #292b2d. Hover on a primary button (ink mixed with 12% white). `white` text on it reads 14.3:1.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: #f0503d. The brand colour, used with restraint: the wordmark plate, the featured AI Essentials cover, the primary button's disc, the current-nav underline, outcome bullets and the Educators audience. Text on it is `ink` (5.2:1), never white. Not a text colour on white (3.5:1).

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: #ffece8. Coral at 12% on white: the Educators selected-lesson tint and finish panel. `ink` and `muted` text read on it.

tokens.name: educators
tokens.usage: Educators audience (Teaching with AI): label dot, opened course cover, play button, progress fill, completion icons and the selected lesson marker.

tokens.name: educators-soft
tokens.usage: Educators soft tint behind the selected lesson and the finish panel.

tokens.name: leaders
tokens.usage: #5471f5. Leaders audience (Leading AI): label dot, opened course cover, lesson controls. Lettering on it is `cover-ink` (5.1:1); `ink` reaches only 4.5:1, so keep `ink` to 24px and above here.

tokens.name: leaders-soft
tokens.usage: #e9efff. Leaders soft tint behind the selected lesson and the finish panel.

tokens.name: builders
tokens.usage: #009479. Builders audience (Building with AI): label dot, opened course cover, lesson controls. Lettering on it is `cover-ink` (5.5:1) or `ink` (4.8:1).

tokens.name: builders-soft
tokens.usage: #e5f2ee. Builders soft tint behind the selected lesson and the finish panel.

tokens.name: cover-ink
tokens.usage: #000000. Black lettering on the coloured cover of an opened course, so small captions stay readable on every audience colour (5.1:1 and above).

tokens.name: video-caption
tokens.usage: #b4b5b6. Small hint text inside the `ink` video frame (white mixed with 28% ink), 9:1 on `ink`.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Header lockup, first word: kompass in Onest 600. Followed after a 0.10em gap, on the same baseline, by `wordmark-word`.

styles.name: wordmark-word
styles.usage: Header lockup, companion word in the lighter Onest 400: education, learning or solutions. Always lowercase, on one line with `wordmark`.

styles.name: wordmark-sm
styles.usage: Lockup on course covers, first word at 600; 18px inside the video frame.

styles.name: wordmark-sm-word
styles.usage: Lockup on course covers, companion word at 400.

styles.name: app-icon
styles.usage: The ke square icon at 64px; 20px type at 32px and 13px at 20px.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Course cover titles, clamp(2.8rem, 1.6rem + 3cqi, 4rem); 48px on narrow screens.

styles.name: page-title
styles.sample: Courses for teaching, leading and building.
styles.usage: Page h1, clamp(2.1rem, 1.2rem + 3cqi, 3rem), balanced wrapping, about 17ch wide.

styles.name: dashboard-title
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off.
styles.usage: My learning h1; 31px on narrow screens.

styles.name: mini-cover
styles.usage: Short title on a catalogue card's grey thumbnail.

styles.name: promo-title
styles.usage: Main-site course cover and promotional panels on `mist`.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Featured and continue-card h2 (1.3 leading on two lines), lesson h1.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Section h2 on course and dashboard pages.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Recommendation card titles.

styles.name: heading-xs
styles.usage: Course card h3 and the syllabus heading.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Get to know Gemini Notebook before working through curriculum planning.
styles.usage: Lesson and course descriptions, at most 65ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Find practical ways to use AI in your work.
styles.usage: Default text; never below 16px in inputs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Plan and build a full stack chatbot application with Claude Code.
styles.usage: Course card descriptions in `muted`, dropdown links, footers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, header navigation, sidebar items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta rows, audience labels (500), progress labels, filter chips (500).

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Mini-cover kicker, video duration and hint, plate captions.

spacing.note: The previews use exact pixel values rather than a stepped scale; these are the recurring ones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between filter chips.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, meta row gap, breadcrumb gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Header wrap gap, gap between wordmark plates.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap inside feature copy, meta row column gap, sidebar group spacing.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap inside a course card; filter row bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Course card padding and catalogue grid gap.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Recommendation card padding; space under page intros.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Main top padding, featured course bottom margin, continue-card padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Section padding and margin above each ruled section; feature copy padding at full width.

tokens.name: gutter-min
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on narrow screens: clamp(20px, 3.8cqi, 46px).

tokens.name: gutter-max
tokens.usage: Page side gutter at full width.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: ke icon at 20px.

tokens.name: radius-7
tokens.usage: ke icon at 32px.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Selects, sidebar items, syllabus lesson rows.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Text areas.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Course cards, syllabus, video frame, opened course cover, finish panel, wordmark plates.

tokens.name: radius-14
tokens.usage: Featured course and continue cards; ke icon at 64px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, the outlined sign-in link.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Audience dots, the button disc, the play button, the avatar, lesson status circles.

tokens.name: target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every control and link row.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary button height.

tokens.name: button-disc
tokens.usage: Coloured disc at the end of a primary button; 29px in the main-site header CTA.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: Play button in the video frame.

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Learner initial.

tokens.name: audience-dot
tokens.usage: Dot before an audience label; 9px inside a filter chip.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Open app sidebar width.

tokens.name: rail-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed app sidebar: icons only, accessible names kept.

tokens.name: syllabus
tokens.usage: Course contents column beside the lesson.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline: 3px solid `ink` (white inside the video frame), offset 4px.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus outline.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Progress bar height.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Buttons, links and summaries while pressed.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: The main-site navigation dropdown panel, the only shadow in the system.
